title: Measure
ble_body: Reading from the gauge comes with the development build.
empty_body: Connect the gauge and start a new measurement to begin.
vin_hint: Optional; without it the measurement stays incomplete.
ble.title: SmartPTG gauge
ble.hint: Connect the gauge to fill the selected part from the probe.
ble.pick_part: Tap a part below to measure it.
ble.pick_hint: Switch the SmartPTG on and keep it close to the phone.
ble.error.unsupported: This phone does not support Bluetooth LE.
ble.error.unauthorized: Allow Bluetooth access in Settings to connect the gauge.
ble.error.powered_off: Turn Bluetooth on to connect the gauge.
ble.error.location_off: Turn on Location to search for Bluetooth devices.
ble.error.not_found: The gauge was not found. Is it on and nearby?
ble.error.connect: Could not connect to the gauge. Try again.
ble.error.service: This device is not a supported gauge.
ble.error.timeout: The gauge did not answer in time.
ble.error.curve: The gauge's calibration curve could not be downloaded; readings need it once (internet required).
ble.error.stream: Readings from the gauge stopped. Connect again.
ble.error.not_ready: Bluetooth is not ready yet. Answer the permission prompt and try again.
ble.no_data: No data from the gauge for 10 seconds. Is it on and nearby?
ble.not_calibrated_hint: This gauge is not calibrated; values use the factory curve.
ble.device.none_body: Connect your SmartPTG; the last gauge connected becomes the default on this phone.
ble.device.serial_unknown: The serial arrives with the first measurement frame
ble.device.calibrate_needs_connection: To calibrate, connect the gauge and wait for its factory curve to load.
ble.device.delete_confirm_body: The default gauge is removed from this phone and disconnected. Calibration records are kept.
ble.cal.title: Calibration
ble.cal.intro: Zero calibration adds a frequency offset to the steel (Fe) and aluminium (Al) channels so the gauge reads the {{um}} µm reference foil correctly. Have the foil and the steel and aluminium plates ready.
ble.cal.intro_fe_only: Zero calibration adds a frequency offset to the steel (Fe) channel so the gauge reads the {{um}} µm reference foil correctly. This model does not measure aluminium. Have the foil and the steel plate ready.
ble.cal.instruction_fe: Lay the {{um}} µm foil on the steel plate, press the probe straight onto the foil and tap Measure. Keep the probe still until it finishes.
ble.cal.instruction_al: Lay the {{um}} µm foil on the aluminium plate, press the probe straight onto the foil and tap Measure. Keep the probe still until it finishes.
ble.cal.error.unstable: The reading is unsteady. Hold the probe straight and still on the foil and try again.
ble.cal.error.timeout: No steady reading within 5 seconds. Press the probe onto the foil and try again.
ble.cal.error.not_ready: The gauge is not connected or its factory curve is not loaded.
ble.cal.no_permission: Calibrating needs the permission to upload measurements.
ble.cal.verify_hint: Measure the foil again and check it reads about {{um}} µm. The record is shared with the team once online.
map_unavailable: No part map for this body type.
values_hint_gauge: Tap a part, then touch the surface with the gauge probe. Values come only from the gauge.
step_vehicle_hint: Identify the vehicle first. You can keep a draft on this phone and continue later.
vin_hint_send: Optional; needed to save the measurement.
body_type_hint: If you pick one, measuring guides you for that body.
vin_required_to_send: Enter the VIN to save the measurement (tap the vehicle).
ble.device.probe_hint: Touch a surface with the probe to read.
ble.device.disconnected_body: Turn the gauge on and keep it near the phone.
ble.device.calibrate_cta_body: For accurate readings, calibrate Fe and Al with the reference foils. It takes about a minute.
ble.device.button_hint: Gauge button: on a surface it takes the value at once; in the air a short press goes to the next part, holding it removes the last value.
guide.all_done: All points measured. You can save the measurement.
body_change_body: Point readings taken for this body are removed.
